mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_log (query_text, normalized_query, result_count, top_scenario_id, source, latency_ms, anonymous_id_hash, user_id) VALUES (#{queryText}, #{normalizedQuery}, #{resultCount}, #{topScenarioId}, #{source}, #{latencyMs}, #{anonymousIdHash}, #{userId})
INSERT INTO search_block_log (query_length, pii_types, source, anonymous_id_hash, user_id) VALUES (#{queryLength}, #{piiTypes}, #{source}, #{anonymousIdHash}, #{userId})

INSERT INTO popular_query_daily (stat_date, normalized_query, query_text_sample, search_count, no_result_count, top_result_scenario_id) SELECT CAST(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS date) AS stat_date, normalized_query, min(query_text) AS query_text_sample, count(*)::int AS search_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE result_count = 0)::int AS no_result_count, max(top_scenario_id) FILTER (WHERE top_scenario_id IS NOT NULL) AS top_result_scenario_id FROM search_log WHERE CAST(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS date) = #{statDate} GROUP BY CAST(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS date), normalized_query
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM search_log WHERE created_at < #{cutoff}
SELECT count(*) FROM search_block_log WHERE created_at < #{cutoff}
